notes:
Base E2-F6 (EF/PL mount, MFR #E1901/E2-F6 PL) has NO SDI output and no genlock — those were added later in the "E2-F6 Mark II" variant (confirmed via B&H's key-feature comparison, where "HDMI, SDI, and Genlock Connectivity" is listed as a differentiator specific to Mark II models and absent from the base E2-F6). Do not confuse this record with E2-F6 Mark II/Pro/S6 variants, which have different I/O.

Several ports use Z CAM's proprietary LEMO connectors, which have no dedicated id in the provided connector taxonomy; each such port is mapped to the closest listed connector and flagged in its own note (5-pin LEMO mic input -> xlr5; 2-pin LEMO DC in/out -> dc-barrel; 4-pin LEMO x2 serial/control -> rs232; 2.5mm LANC -> trs-3.5).

Also present but not listed as ports (no matching connector type / not a signal-or-power port): external Wi-Fi antenna connector (Wi-Fi 4 / 802.11n, likely RP-SMA — no RF-antenna id in the taxonomy) and a single CFast 2.0 media card slot (storage, not I/O). Built-in stereo microphone is not an external port.

Not rack-mountable (compact cinema-camera body, ~99 x 91 x 89mm without protrusions, ~1090g) — rackUnits omitted.

Sources cross-checked: manufacturer product page (primary, used for exact wording/voltages) and B&H Photo's structured "Specs" tab for the EF-mount SKU (used to confirm exact port counts/directions, notably the "2x LEMO 4-Pin (Camera Interface) Control Input/Output" serial ports and "1x 5-Pin LEMO Input" audio detail): https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1496581-REG/z_cam_e2_f6_professional_full_frame_6k.html/specs

ports.name: HDMI Out
ports.note: HDMI 2.0 Type A; outputs up to C4K/UHD 4K @59.94-60fps, 10-bit 4:2:2.

ports.name: USB-C
ports.note: USB 3.0 Type-C; camera control & data transfer only (not a card-reader passthrough).

ports.name: LAN (Ethernet)
ports.note: Gigabit Ethernet; used for live view/monitor, control, file transfer, and IP streaming.

ports.name: Mic In (5-Pin)
ports.note: Manufacturer labels this a 5-pin LEMO port for dual-channel XLR microphone input; requires a separately available LEMO-to-dual-XLR3 breakout cable. LEMO is not in the connector list, so xlr5 (nearest 5-pin audio connector) is used as an approximation.

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: 2-pin LEMO power input, 6.8V–16.8V DC (bundled LEMO power cable included). LEMO is not in the connector list; dc-barrel used as nearest external-DC-input analog — actual connector is a 2-pin LEMO, not a coaxial barrel jack.

ports.name: DC Out (Aux Power)
ports.note: 2-pin LEMO auxiliary power output, 12V DC, for powering accessories. Same LEMO-vs-barrel approximation as DC In.

ports.name: LANC Remote
ports.note: 2.5mm sub-mini jack, Sony LANC-compatible remote control (incl. power on/off). 2.5mm is not in the connector list; trs-3.5 used as nearest TRS-jack analog — actual jack is smaller (2.5mm, not 3.5mm).

ports.name: Serial Port 1
ports.note: One of two 4-pin LEMO "Camera Interface" control ports (per B&H spec table) for accessory/camera control. Physical connector is a 4-pin LEMO, not a DB9/RS232 jack; rs232 used as nearest serial-control connector id since no LEMO option exists.

ports.name: Serial Port 2
ports.note: Second of two identical 4-pin LEMO camera-control serial ports; same approximation as Serial Port 1.
